title: 第4179章 都结束了第4178章 葛丹阳出手
content_zh:
大商都城。
遮天巨手遮望眼，黑暗中，那一道无形气浪汹涌澎湃，硬生生将天际俯视众生的那双眼睛遮住。
李园前院，大赤天捂着被青霜剑气贯穿的胸膛，刚要说什么，突然察觉到上方的异常，毫不犹豫，转身冲向了后方的还珠。
只是，就在大赤天准备破釜沉舟夺取肉身的一刻，还珠身旁，空间波纹出现，罗蒂凭空走出，一把拽过眼前女子，随后，两人的身影同时消失不见。
“逃得了吗！”
大赤天见状，冷声一语，瞬至两人来到消失的地方，手中九炼浮舍挥过，竟是直接将虚空撕开。
超出认知的一幕，空间黑腔中，罗蒂看到大赤天撕开了虚空，脸色一变，没有想到这位众神之主会反应如此之快，震惊之余，当机立断，一把将还珠推入了空间乱流。
霎时，空间乱流席卷，直接吞没了还珠的身影。
“你找死！”
大赤天看到这一结果，怒上心头，一掌拍出，轰然落在了罗蒂的胸膛。
顿时，空间黑腔中，一瀑鲜血飞溅而出，罗蒂的身影也被强行打了出来。
肉眼看见，罗蒂胸膛，几乎被大赤天一掌击穿，那一颗跳动的魔心，若隐若现，触目惊心。
“合！”
夜色下，罗蒂强忍一身重创，右手虚握，砰然一声，第一时间将空间黑腔关闭。
正当罗蒂被大赤天重创，而大赤天又分神准备去找自己的肉身之时，前院中，不知何时，黑麟大天尊悄无声息地出现在重伤的罗蒂身后，一掌贯入其后心。
“呃！”
痛苦的闷哼声随之响起，罗蒂脚下一个踉跄，转身看向后方的黑麟大天尊，面露难以置信之色。
“古神之心，现在是本座的了！”黑夜中，黑麟大天尊语气冰冷地说了一句，旋即一把将那一颗跳动的心脏拽出。
失去旧神之心，罗蒂那实体化的肉身，仅仅一瞬间，便变得虚幻起来。
“魔主、师兄，快，将魔心抢回来！”

李园上空，李子夜看到这一幕，急声喊道，“千万不能让他将魔心带走，不然，一旦他踏足三花境，九州就完了！”
李园外，书生、女魃等人不等某人的提醒，已然冲入了前院，出手阻拦黑麟大天尊。
只是，突来的变数，实在太过突然，书生和女魃的合围之势尚未成，黑麟大天尊已然先一步冲出。
“快，拦住他！”
虚空上，李子夜着急地喊道，“不能让他逃了。”
夜色下，黑麟大天尊一手抓着魔心，一手拿着黑焰魔刀，疾速朝着西边掠去，目标赫然就是远方的南天门。
作为南天门世界七位大天尊之一，黑麟大天尊自然知晓，要进出南天门世界，天之物便是其中的关键。
而旧神之王的心脏，就是天之物之一！
所以，黑麟大天尊在拿到魔心的第一时间，便毫不犹豫地朝着南天门方向赶去。
只要他回到南天门，借助古神之心证得古神之境，届时，天上、人间，唯他独尊！
这个时间，不需要多久，有了古神之心，他可以非常确定，这一天，近在眼前。
黑夜中，黑麟大赤天急速冲出了大商都城，速度之快，肉眼难辨，后方，书生、女魃匆匆追赶，却是始终无法追上。
而速度最快的罗蒂，如今，重创一身，失去魔心后，实力更是大减，根本已没有力气再去帮忙。
大商都城上方，那卷动的阴气漩涡前，赵文和、王真人两位西方鬼帝看到眼前急转而下的局势，对视一眼，脸上皆露出诧异之色。
最后的赢家，竟然是黑麟大天尊！
当真匪夷所思。
“不可思议。”
王真人看着西边远去的黑麟大天尊，感慨道。
content_en:
Great commercial capital.
The giant hand covering the sky covered his eyes. In the darkness, the invisible air wave surged, forcibly covering the eyes that looked down at all living beings from the sky.
In the front yard of Liyuan, Da Chitian was holding his chest that was pierced by Qingshuang sword energy. He was about to say something when he suddenly noticed something abnormal above him. Without hesitation, he turned around and rushed towards Huanzhu behind him.
However, just when Da Chitian was about to risk everything to seize his body, ripples in space appeared next to Huanzhu. Luo Di walked out of thin air and grabbed the woman in front of him. Then, the two figures disappeared at the same time.
"Can you escape?"
When Da Chitian saw this, he said something coldly. In an instant, the two of them arrived at the place where they disappeared. He waved the Nine Refinement Fushe in his hand, tearing open the void directly.
A scene beyond his comprehension. In the black space of space, Luo Di saw the Great Red Sky tearing open the void. His expression changed. He did not expect that the Lord of the Gods would react so quickly. In shock, he made a prompt decision and pushed Huan Zhu into the turbulent flow of space.
In an instant, turbulence swept through the space, directly swallowing Huan Zhu's figure.
"You're looking for death!"
When Da Chitian saw this result, he became angry and slapped a palm, which landed on Luo Ti's chest.
Suddenly, a waterfall of blood splashed out from the black cavity of the space, and Rody's figure was also forcibly punched out.
Seen with the naked eye, Luo Di's chest was almost penetrated by Da Chitian's palm, and the beating demon heart was looming, which was shocking.
"Come together!"
In the darkness of the night, Rody endured the heavy injuries, held his right hand empty, and with a bang, immediately closed the black cavity in space.
Just as Luo Ti was severely injured by Da Chi Tian, ​​and Da Chi Tian was distracted and preparing to find his own body, at some point in the front yard, Heilin Heavenly Lord appeared quietly behind the seriously injured Luo Ti and penetrated his heart with a palm.
"Ugh!"
A painful groan followed, and Rody stumbled, turning around to look at the Black Lin Heavenly Lord behind him, with a look of disbelief on his face.
"The heart of the ancient god belongs to me now!" In the dark night, Heilin Great Heavenly Lord said in a cold tone, and immediately pulled out the beating heart.
Without the heart of the old god, Rodi's physical body became illusory in just an instant.
"Demon Lord, senior brother, hurry up and get the devil's heart back!"
Over Li Yuan, Li Ziye saw this scene and shouted urgently, "Don't let him take away the devil's heart, otherwise, once he sets foot in the Three Flowers Realm, Kyushu will be over!"
Outside Li Garden, the scholar, the nun and others did not wait for someone to remind them, but they rushed into the front yard and tried to stop the Great Heavenly Lord Heilin.
However, the sudden change was too sudden. Before the encirclement of the scholar and the female demon could be completed, the Black Lin Great Heavenly Lord had already rushed out first.
"Quick, stop him!"
In the void, Li Ziye shouted anxiously, "We can't let him escape."
Under the night, Heilin Great Heavenly Lord grasped the Demonic Heart in one hand and the Black Flame Demonic Sword in the other, and quickly swept towards the west. The target was clearly the Nantianmen in the distance.
As one of the seven Great Heavenly Lords in the Nantianmen world, Heilin Great Heavenly Lord naturally knows that to enter and exit the Nantianmen world, heavenly things are the key.
And the heart of the King of Old Gods is one of the things in heaven!
Therefore, as soon as Heilin Great Heavenly Lord obtained the Demon Heart, he rushed towards Nantianmen without hesitation.
As long as he returns to Nantianmen and uses the heart of the ancient gods to achieve the realm of the ancient gods, then he will be the only one in heaven and earth!
This time will not take long. With the Heart of the Ancient God, he can be very sure that this day is close before his eyes.
In the dark night, Heilin Dachitian rushed out of the Great Shang Capital City at a speed that was difficult to distinguish with the naked eye. Behind him, the scholar and the female demon hurriedly chased him, but they were never able to catch up.
As for Rody, the fastest, he was severely injured. After losing his demon heart, his strength was greatly reduced, and he no longer had the strength to help.
Above the Great Shang Capital City, in front of the swirling vortex of Yin Qi, two Western ghosts, Zhao Wenhe and Wang Zhenren,When the emperor saw the sudden turn of events in front of him, he looked at each other with a look of surprise on his face.
The final winner turned out to be Heilin Great Heavenly Lord!
It's really unbelievable.
"Incredible."
Master Wang looked at the Black Lin Heavenly Lord walking away to the west and said with emotion.
